name: Shirtmasters
old_description: We put quality and care before all else ensuring that our clients have what they need to outfit their employees, look good on a family vacation or promote their event in a memorable way.
about:
Shirtmasters operates from Chichester, New Hampshire, just outside Concord. The company has served the custom apparel market for over 30 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The business provides screen printing, embroidery, and promotional product services through in-house production departments. A graphic design team supports custom artwork, and the company sources blank apparel from over 100 brands. Typical orders range from single-name embroidery on uniforms to multi-color screen prints on hundreds of shirts.

Clients include sports teams, corporations, municipalities, schools and universities, small businesses, and restaurants. The company also supplies decorated apparel for trade shows and events across New England and nationally.

Shirtmasters emphasizes personal service, environmental consciousness, and community involvement as core differentiators. The company cites a typical turnaround of two weeks or less for most of the year, with dedicated sales representatives guiding customers through brand selection and design. Its stated mission stresses quality service, putting customers first, being conscious of the environment, and helping the local New Hampshire community.
